title: Atlas Agency: weekly ops sync
attendees: Jonas Weber <jonas@atlas.example>, Amara Diallo <amara@atlas.example>, Felix Braun <felix@atlas.example>, Nina Kowalski <nina@atlas.example>
transcript:
Jonas: Quick sync. First, the new contract template. Legal signed it off on Friday.
Amara: So from now on every new client uses version 3?
Jonas: Yes, decided. Amara, can you update the onboarding checklist so it links to v3 and tell the account team?
Amara: I'll do it by Wednesday.
Jonas: Felix, timesheets.
Felix: Still blocked. Half the team can't log in to Harvest since we switched to Google SSO.
Jonas: That's been two weeks. Who owns the SSO setup?
Nina: I set it up. I think it's a domain mapping issue. I'll look at it today.
Jonas: Thanks, Nina. Felix, once it's fixed, can you remind everyone to backfill October hours?
Felix: Yes.
Jonas: Last thing. Hiring. We need the job ad for the junior account manager role up this week.
Amara: I have a draft. I'll share it with you tomorrow for review.
Jonas: Great. And we agreed last month to try a no-meeting Friday. Let's start this Friday. Everyone OK?
Nina: Yes.
Felix: Yes.
Jonas: Someone needs to tell the clients' account leads so nobody books Friday calls.
Jonas: Hmm, let's figure that out later.
